title: LRU cache simulation
prompt: Write `lru_run(capacity, ops)`. `ops` is a list of ['put', key, value] or ['get', key]. Simulate an LRU cache of the given capacity (a get or put marks the key most recently used; putting a new key when full evicts the least recently used key). Return the list of results of the 'get' operations in order, using -1 for a missing key.
